scripts.dev: npm run build -w @eduquest/contracts && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @eduquest/api" "npm run dev -w @eduquest/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eduquest/contracts && npm run build -w @eduquest/web && npm run build -w @eduquest/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @eduquest/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @eduquest/api && npm run typecheck -w @eduquest/web
